mode: reviewer-style claim/evidence/scope audit; no provider calls
venue_assumption: ICLR 2027 main conference, 8-page main body with references and appendix outside the main-body count

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Persistent canary exposure was not detected under the preregistered five-round setting.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: 20 evolve instances, one model/runtime, fixed topology; the manuscript explicitly avoids a non-leakage claim.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: The released score scale is causally dominated by output length, but length removal is not a validated utility improvement.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: Prospective interventions span DeepSeek and Qwen; utility directions are reported without being promoted.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Recorded candidate pools impose a small selector headroom bound.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: The bound applies only to persisted candidates and binary executable utility.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Independent trajectories enlarge task-relevant support and raise the executable oracle from 0.60 to 0.80 at roughly 3x token cost.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: 20 tasks and one benchmark; the nested design is not a sign-symmetric treatment test and does not identify a multi-agent architectural effect.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Direct stochastic generation can collapse onto one invalid endpoint with or without repair conditioning on two selected hard failures.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: Two selected tasks are mechanism evidence, not a prevalence estimate; the manuscript states this scope.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Selector-level DP becomes non-vacuous after support expansion, but the work does not provide end-to-end DP.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: Only selected-index/output release is protected under a narrow adjacency; memories, messages, prompts, topology, and stopping remain trusted.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Removing bounded symbolic pre-checks and distance filtering reduces held-out executable coverage in a live DeepSeek component ablation.
claim_evidence_matrix.risk_reason: Fixed 18-task cohort, one model and one benchmark; the protocol retains local state verification and is explicitly not an architecture-level causal estimate.

reviewer_risks.risk: The paper may be judged as an audit of premises rather than a new DP method.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_already_present: The paper makes the premise-audit question explicit and labels the DP result selector-level.
reviewer_risks.remaining_action: Do not claim end-to-end privacy or a new private architecture; emphasize the phenomenon-to-remedy-to-escape arc.

reviewer_risks.risk: The two-task response-collapse mechanism could be overgeneralized.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_already_present: The term is scoped to selected hard failures and the public-only control reverses the initial explanation.
reviewer_risks.remaining_action: Keep the scope word in abstract, contributions, Results, and limitations; no additional calls are required for the current claim.

reviewer_risks.risk: X2 can distract from the privacy audit because it is one benchmark and exploratory.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_already_present: X2 is framed as a planning diagnostic and the live component result is bounded.
reviewer_risks.remaining_action: Keep X2 in the current compact paragraph and appendix; do not promote it to a headline architecture result.

reviewer_risks.risk: Reviewers may ask why no end-to-end private agent was built.
reviewer_risks.mitigation_already_present: The manuscript explains that the audited premises fail or are weak before end-to-end calibration is meaningful.
reviewer_risks.remaining_action: Treat end-to-end DP as a scope boundary and future architecture, not as a missing baseline to be silently implied.

verdict.scientific_position: Defensible as a bounded empirical audit of privacy-utility premises with a phenomenon-remedy-escape arc.
verdict.largest_risk: Reviewers may require an end-to-end private evolving-agent system or may treat the two-task collapse result as overgeneralized.
verdict.recommended_action: Freeze the empirical claim set and perform final venue/reviewer response preparation; no additional provider calls are required for the current claims.
